AgentGuardScanStatsResponseSchema.description:
Summary cards for the skill scans page.

The three numbers deliberately use different grains: the first counts distinct
skills, the other two count per scan. A skill scanned thirty times with four
findings each is 1 unique skill and 120 findings.

top_vulnerability.description: The most frequently found vulnerability type in the window, or null when nothing was found.

total_vulnerabilities_found.description: Findings across all scans in the window, counted per scan rather than per distinct skill, so a skill scanned repeatedly contributes its findings each time.

unique_skills_scanned.description: Distinct skills scanned in the window, counted by fingerprint, with the change against the preceding window of equal length. A skill scanned many times counts once. Windows are whole UTC days.

AgentGuardScanStatsResponseSchema.title: AgentGuardScanStatsResponseSchema

AgentGuardSkillStatsResponseSchema.description: Summary cards for the Skill Scanning Rules tab.

most_violated_rules.description: Catalog rules ranked by failures in the window, highest first, filtered to rules that are still enabled, capped at 10. Null when the rule configuration could not be read, since neither filtering nor naming is possible; an empty list means the tenant genuinely tripped no enabled rules. Counts here need not sum to total_rule_violations: failures attributed to rules that have since been disabled stay in the total but drop out of this list, as do any beyond the tenth.
most_violated_rules.title: Most Violated Rules

total_enabled_rules.description: Distinct skill rules currently switched on for the tenant, counting both blocking and alert-only rules. Null when the rule configuration could not be read, which is distinct from 0 -- 0 means the tenant genuinely has no rules enabled.
total_enabled_rules.title: Total Enabled Rules

total_rule_violations.description: Failed rule evaluations in the requested window, with the change against the preceding window of equal length. Skills the tenant has trusted via a skill override are excluded.

AgentGuardSkillStatsResponseSchema.title: AgentGuardSkillStatsResponseSchema
